gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-martel: Martel reads like a serif with a restrained gap between thick and thin, its apertures open like a horseshoe magnet. Bruno Ace draws everything in one ruler-straight line; Martel handles the reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-mate: Mate's rounded letters look cupped rather than clenched, with a soft step from heavy to light in every stroke. Bruno Ace, drawn like rod stock, gives the pair its sharpest quality: horizontals and verticals of identical thickness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-mate-sc: Mate SC is a text serif with a faint nib-pressure shift, like a lightly pressed brush lifting early at the curve ends. And Bruno Ace, with its lowercase n whose arch and stem match, supplies the strongest contrast to that softness.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Nanum Myeongjo is a text serif with quiet modulation, its curve tips stopping short of touching. Nanum Myeongjo carries the reading while Bruno Ace, rounded-nib and unswollen at stroke ends, lingers one character per beat above it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-serif-hk: Dignified Noto Serif HK leaves a generous gap where each curve ends, and its crossbars run a touch thinner than the stems. But Bruno Ace holds its curves at full thickness through the shoulders, so the two feel like metal rod beside ink.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-serif-jp: Rod-straight Bruno Ace, with counters that stay connected to the outside, sits against Noto Serif JP's unclenched c and faintly modulated line. Across a long passage the text serif would settle into a comfortable midpoint between flat strokes and dramatic ones.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-serif-kr: Marker-bold lines and a lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm define Bruno Ace, whose diagonals are as thick as its horizontals. And Noto Serif KR, a text serif with wide s curves and finer crossbars, would keep a long stretch smooth.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-serif-sc: Bruno Ace feels like tracing a single thick thread, its counters staying connected to the outside as the line never changes width. Noto Serif SC does the opposite job well, swelling gently on its rounded curves with c openings you can see through.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-serif-tc: Noto Serif TC is a text serif whose stems are only a shade heavier than the connecting arms, and its rounded tops thin slightly. And if the size needs adjusting, nudge the body up first, leaving Bruno Ace's marker-like line alone.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-petrona: Bruno Ace looks like glass tubing bent into letters, its ruler-drawn line unchanging from end to end. And Petrona, a classic serif with a shallow terminal curl, can take a slightly larger size so its gently thickening shoulders show.
